title: Social Policy of Large Language Models: How GPT, Claude, DeepSeek and Grok Allocate Social Budgets in Spain and Germany

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated hypothetical social budget allocations across twelve macro-areas against approximate OECD reference budgets to identify systematic structural over-allocations (e.g., housing, employment) and under-allocations (e.g., pensions, health).

Comparing the budget percentage allocated to gender equality, LGBTI+ rights, and anti-discrimination between Western models (Claude, GPT-4o, Grok) and a Chinese model (DeepSeek) to evaluate the influence of training data and cultural frames.

Measuring the percentage of the budget allocated to politically sensitive categories, such as the integration of ethnic minorities, migrants, and unaccompanied minors, to determine if they are systematically under-represented (allocated less than 2%).
